# Anavya Infotech

> Custom Software Development, AI Automation, Web Applications & Technical SEO Engineering Company.

Anavya Infotech is an IT consulting and software engineering firm based in India, serving startups, growing SMBs, and global enterprises. We design, build, and optimize high-performance web applications, autonomous AI chatbots, custom CRM platforms, headless e-commerce storefronts, and search engine visibility systems.

## Core Capabilities

- **Custom Web Application Engineering**: Next.js App Router, React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, serverless architectures, and real-time telemetry.
- **AI & Automation Systems**: Autonomous LLM support agents, RAG vector search (Qdrant/Pinecone), OpenAI/Claude API integrations, and workflow pipelines.
- **Bespoke Enterprise CRMs**: Custom database schemas (PostgreSQL/Supabase), lead allocation webhooks, and full data ownership with zero per-seat licensing fees.
- **Headless E-Commerce**: Sub-second page loads, custom checkout integrations, and high Core Web Vitals performance.
- **Technical SEO & Growth**: Built-in JSON-LD schemas, automated sitemaps, OpenGraph metadata, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

## Primary Services

- [Business Website Development](https://anavyainfotech.com/services/business-website): Local SEO, India national scale, and global enterprise setups.
- [Web Application Engineering](https://anavyainfotech.com/services/web-applications): Custom React and Next.js cloud platforms.
- [AI Chatbots & Automation](https://anavyainfotech.com/services/ai-chatbot): Autonomous support agents and workflow deflection.
- [Custom CRM Software](https://anavyainfotech.com/services/crm-custom-software): Tailored business CRM & internal tool suites.
- [Headless E-Commerce](https://anavyainfotech.com/services/ecommerce): Decoupled storefronts for speed and conversions.
- [Corporate Branding](https://anavyainfotech.com/services/branding): Visual identity systems, Figma design tokens, and UI kits.
- [Technical SEO Services](https://anavyainfotech.com/services/technical-seo): Speed audits, schema markup, and search rankings.
